# Button group

Reference: Minimal UI kit "Buttons" page, section "Button group" (content only). Created with `/component`.
Reference URL: https://minimals.cc/components/mui/buttons

## Purpose
Joins related Buttons into one control (segmented actions).

## Anatomy
```
div[role="group"][data-ok-button-group][data-ok-orientation][aria-label]?
  (button|a)[data-ok-button]…        regular Buttons (see button.md), one per action
```

## Options
<!-- options:button-group (generated by `pnpm specs:options` from the schema in packages/core/src/anatomy/anatomy.ts) -->
Root: `data-ok-button-group`. Unknown values fall back to the default.

| React | HTML | Kind | Values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `orientation` | `data-ok-orientation="…"` | style | `horizontal` `vertical` | `horizontal` | Row or column. |
| `fullWidth` | `data-ok-full-width` | flag | boolean | off | Stretch to the container width; buttons share it. |
| `variant` | `data-ok-variant="…"` on each `[data-ok-button]` | style | `text` `contained` `outlined` `soft` | `outlined` | Passed to every button. |
| `color` | `data-ok-color="…"` on each `[data-ok-button]` | style | `inherit` `primary` `secondary` `info` `success` `warning` `error` `black` `white` | `inherit` | Passed to every button. |
| `size` | `data-ok-size="…"` on each `[data-ok-button]` | style | `sm` `md` `lg` `xl` | `md` | Passed to every button. |
| `disableElevation` | `data-ok-disable-elevation` on each `[data-ok-button]` | flag | boolean | off | Passed to every button (on by default in a group, as in the reference). |
| `disabled` | `disabled` on each `[data-ok-button]` | native | boolean | off | Passed to every button. |
<!-- /options:button-group -->

React passes `variant` (default `outlined`, as MUI), `color`, `size`, `disabled` and
`disableElevation` (default on, as in the reference) to every direct child Button (a child prop
wins); HTML writes them on each button (`data-ok-disable-elevation` included).

## States
The group only joins its children: outer corners rounded, inner corners square; a 1px separator
between buttons (contained: `dark` 48 %, neutral grey 32 %; text: `channel` 48 % / 32 %; soft:
`dark` 24 %; disabled: `--ok-action-disabled-bg`); outlined buttons share borders. Contained
buttons have no hover shadow inside a group. A focused button is raised above its neighbours.

## Behavior
CSS only, no runtime.

## Keyboard
Native: `Tab` moves through the buttons; `Enter` / `Space` activate.

## Accessibility
`role="group"`; give it an `aria-label` when the buttons need a shared context.

## Events / API
None: CSS only, no runtime. React forwards `ref` (`HTMLDivElement`); group props reach **direct**
child elements only (`cloneElement`).

## Responsive
The group doesn't wrap: use `vertical` (or fewer buttons) on narrow screens.

## Upstream API mapping
Upstream: MUI `ButtonGroup`, mui.com/material-ui/api/button-group/.

| Upstream | Owlky | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children`, `orientation`, `fullWidth`, `disabled`, `disableElevation` | same | kept | reach **direct** child Buttons only (`cloneElement`); `disableElevation` on by default (reference) |
| `variant` | `variant` | kept | default `outlined` (as MUI); + `soft` |
| `color` | `color` | kept | default `inherit` (MUI `primary`); + `black` / `white` |
| `size` (`small` · `medium` · `large`) | `size` (`sm` · `md` · `lg` · `xl`) | renamed | |
| `component` | — | deferred | root is always `div[role=group]` |
| `disableRipple`, `disableFocusRipple` | — | not applicable | no ripple |
| `sx`, `classes` | — | not applicable | ADR-0015 |

## Parity notes
In HTML, write `data-ok-variant` / `data-ok-color` / `data-ok-size` / `data-ok-disable-elevation` on every button (React does it
from the group's props).
